title: Reporting Currency–Measurement and Presentation of Financial Statements under IAS 21 and IAS 29
summary: Addressed how to select the reporting currency for measuring and presenting financial statements under the old IAS 21 framework. Superseded in 2003.

related.title: The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates
related.relationship: The standard whose 2003 revision superseded SIC-19 by replacing the reporting currency concept with the modern functional currency concept
